landing.documentTitle: Surveyor – Organize and coordinate group activities
landing.signedOverview: See all your surveys, events, packing lists, activity plans and drivers lists in one place.
landing.signedCreate: Quickly create new plans and share links so others can respond or sign up.
landing.signedPacking: Coordinate who brings what and who drives with whom.
landing.signedRights: Keep track of participants, assignments and access rights from your dashboard.
landing.intro: Organize and coordinate group activities in one place.
landing.plan: Plan surveys, events and activity schedules.
landing.share: Share a single link so people can respond or sign up.
landing.link: Keep packing lists and drivers lists together with your events.
landing.dashboard: See everything you created on your personal dashboard.
landing.guestHint: If you received an invitation link, you can also participate as a guest without creating an account.
landing.accessBody: People can take part either with a registered account or as guests using links shared by organizers.
landing.accessDashboard: Your dashboard works as your personal homepage and shows the surveys, events, packing lists, activity plans and drivers lists you have created.
landing.permissionsBody: Surveyor uses a permission system to control who can view and edit entities and their items.
landing.permissionsDetail: Permissions can be assigned to audiences as group permissions and to individual users, while the creator of an entity always keeps full access.

survey.title: Surveys
survey.description: Find suitable dates and collect responses.
survey.point1: Define date combinations such as specific weekdays and weeks of a month.
survey.point2: Let people answer with options like Yes, Maybe or No.
survey.point3: See everyone’s availability in a combined view.
survey.point4: Allow both registered users and guests to participate.

event.title: Events
event.description: Create events with participant registration and links to related plans.
event.point1: Store event details such as title, dates and location.
event.point2: Manage participant registration and track who is attending.
event.point3: Link related packing lists, activity plans and drivers lists.
event.point4: Optionally collect information such as dietary notes.
event.point5: Use invoice pools to assign costs, record payments and see balances.

packing.title: Packing lists
packing.description: Coordinate what needs to be brought for trips or events.
packing.point1: Create items with descriptions and quantities.
packing.point2: Track how many of each item are still needed.
packing.point3: Assign items to people so everyone knows what they bring.
packing.point4: Support participation via shared links, including guests.

activity.title: Activity plans
activity.description: Schedule activities with time slots and roles.
activity.point1: Create time-based schedules organized by date and time.
activity.point2: Define roles for activities, such as helpers or facilitators.
activity.point3: Assign people to activity slots and see who is where.
activity.point4: Track how many assignments participants should take.
activity.point5: Link plans to events to reuse participant lists.
activity.point6: Allow guests to take part using shared plan links.

drivers.title: Drivers lists
drivers.description: Coordinate transportation by organizing drivers and passengers.
drivers.point1: Register drivers and specify the number of seats they offer.
drivers.point2: Let participants sign up for available rides.
drivers.point3: Track who is riding with whom.
drivers.point4: Support participation via links so guests can join.

landing.metaDescription: Surveyor helps you organize and coordinate group activities with surveys, events, packing lists, activity plans and drivers lists.
landing.metaKeywords: Surveyor, surveys, events, packing lists, activity plans, drivers lists, group activities
landing.metaSocialDescription: Create surveys, events, packing lists, activity plans and drivers lists in one place and keep an overview on your dashboard.
